description: GEMS2A mission sensor (Weather Stream). The curves are the channel spectral response functions distributed by the EUMETSAT NWP SAF for the RTTOV radiative-transfer model, converted from frequency to wavelength; bands chNN follow the RTTOV channel order.

facility_description: Weather Stream GEMS2A mission (RTTOV platform GEMS2; NWP SAF SRF page).

licence.terms: No terms of use are stated on the NWP SAF SRF pages or in the files. The NWP SAF SRF index lists sensors whose 'SRFs cannot be published due to licence restrictions' separately; this sensor's SRFs are published there.
licence.scope: EUMETSAT NWP SAF distribution of originator data (see notes). Hosted under Nill's 2026-10-26 'host everything' decision.

notes: NWP SAF README_SRF: 'SRF data provided for the GEMS2A mission by Weather Stream October 2025' Zeros added just inside gaps between separate passbands. Pivots agree with the page's central frequencies within 1% except double-sideband channels, whose pivot lies between the sidebands. DetectorType energy is assumed.
